content: Saa7oola ammaneeza
Ye wode Saa7oola Goda kaalizita wodhodayis mandditar qeese halaqitayiko yhanigeez.
Goda oge kaalliza dhiirathitannee maachchita denggiko, accii Yerusalaame ko7odayis, Damasqqo yez Ayihude Woosa Keethitayis dabddaabbe xaafinttoday garkk eza woosseeza.
E yhanigii, Damasqqo katama hellodayis ukkodar, qoppekka salopp wolqqama poo7o e yuushayir poo7eeza.
E sa7a pokkeezazin, «Saa7oola, Saa7oola, abis tana bayithinnee?» giz qaala si7eeza.
Saa7oola, «Godayyo, ne oonoo?» yeegii oycceez. «Taanii, ne bayi7ith Yesuusa» yeegeeza.
Goday eeko, «Denddii katama geloba; ne oothodayis beezizabaza ezayid nees odinttoda» yeegeeza.
Saa7oolara oge yhanigiz asitay akkokka odinttekka eqqii atteeza. Giirth si7inttiza, zin oonakka benttowa.
Saa7oola pokkeez aqaypp denddii be7adar e aafay denggaam ixeeza. Yey gishos, unttii e kushayid aykkii kaalithii Damasqqo gelseeza.
Hayidzii gallas hellodayis E be7adayis danda7ekka; akkokka meekkaya; uzhekkaya.
Damasqqo pettii Hanana giz Yesuusa tamaaray yeza. Goday qoncithar, «Hananaa» yeegii xeegeeza. Hananee mahii, «Ta Godayyo, ta yhaydda yeza» yeegeeza.
Goday eeko, «Denddii luulo ginttinttiz oge yhanigii, Yihuda kara Saa7oola giz xersesepp ye7eez woos woossiz atha koyoba.
Ma Hanana ginttiz athay gelii, Saa7oola nam7intho be7aday garkk fa kushe ezal afa gaddodar qoncithar be7eeza» yeegeeza.
Hanana mahii, «Godayyo, Yerusalaame ne geeshsh asayil afa ye athay ab garkk iita baz ootheezako taanii gaame asaypp si7eeza.
Ma Damasqqo ne suntha xeegizita ubba accodayis, qeese halaqitay ees mawute inggeeza» yeegeeza.
Zin Goday eeko, «Saa7oola Ayihude maaqqekka asay tiina, kaatitay tiinannee Isreele asay tiina, ta suntha ersodayisnnee taas oothoayis maraxintteez miisha maaqqeez gishos ne eeko yhanigoba.
Abis giiko, ta sunthay gishos E waafa waaye ekkodayis beezizako taanii eza beezoda» yeegeeza.

Hananee yhanigii, kara gelii, fa kushe Saa7oolal afa gaddii, «Ta isha Saa7oola, ne ye7eez ogayil nees bentteez Goda Yesuusa, ne be7aday garkkennee Geeshsha Ayyanar kumoday garkk tana azazeeza» yeegeeza.
Ellisii, Saa7oola aafaypp pettii puqo garkkezibazay wodhdhin, Saa7oola nam7intho be7eeza. Ma denddii xammaqintteeza.
Katha mi miinggeeza, Damasqqo yez ammanizitayir xiqqa gallas gam7eeza.
Saa7oola Damasqqo taamarsseeza
Ellisii Saa7oola, «Yesuusa Xooss Na7a» yeegii Damasqqo yez Ayihude Woosa Keethitayid qaala taamarsseeza.
Yeya si7eez ubbay malabaz gi, «Yhay Yerusalaame Yesuusa suntha xeegizita dhabisiza baasannee? Ma yhana ye7eezay unttan accii, qeese halaqitay tiina kanggodayis baasannee?» yeegeeza.
Zin Saa7oola qaala odor minggittar minggittar yhanigeeza. Yesuusa, E Kiristtoosa maaqqeezana milxxi udii odeez gishos Damasqqo yez Ayihuditay ees mahodibaz dhabeeza.
Gaame gallasapp guye Ayihuditay shiiqii, Saa7oola wodhodayis tobbeeza.
Zin Ayihuditay fana wodhodayis qoppeeza Saa7oola si7eeza. Unttii eza wodhodayis qammannee gallas katama penge naagiza.
Zin e tamaaritay eza qamma kanggii, gimbbe gase lukor daachchora wodhiseeza.
Saa7oola Yerusalaame taamarsseeza
Saa7oola Yerusalaame helleez wode ammanizitayir walakinttodayis koyeeza. Zin E Kiristtoosa ammaneezay unttis tuma aazam ixxin ees yashitteeza.
Zin Barnnabaasa Saa7oola hawaaritayko kanggeez. Ogel Goday wayizii qoncceezakonnee nashsheezako, ma Saa7oola Damasqqo Yesuusa sunthayir yashittekka wayizii qaala odeezako unttis geeshshii odeeza.
Saa7oola Yerusalaame wutii Goday sunthayir yashittekka qaala odittar, hawaaritayira wolla yeza.
Ma Saa7oola Girike qaala odeez Ayihuditayra odinttittar palamiza. Zin unttii eza wodhodayis koyeeza.
Ammaniza asitay yeya si7ii, Saa7oola Qisaare kanggii Tersese dakkeeza.
Yihuda, Galilarannee Samaare ubbayid yez woosa keethitay saror yezeeza. Ma miinggeeza; Godayis yashittittar Geeshsha Ayyana minthathor gaanggii gaanggii yhanigeeza.
Phixiroosa Liidarannee Yoophphe taamarsseeza
Phixiroosa gade ubba yuuyttar Liida yez ammaniza asitayko helleeza.
Ezayid hosppun layth muda silii arssal woyi7ii yez Eeniya giz atha denggeeza.
Phixiroosa, «Eeniya, Yesuus Kiristtoosa nena pathiza; denddii ne hiixa denthoba» yeegeeza. Eekka ellisii denddii eqqeeza.
Liidarannee Saarona yez as ubbay Eeniya bi7ii, Godayiko maaqqeeza.
Yoophphe katama pettii Xaabito ginttiz ammaniza asita yeza. (Xaabito guussay gen7e guussii) Iza fa yeza wode ubbayid lo77o baz oothitarannee manqqita maaddittar yezeeza.
Ye wode iza hargginttii yhayqqin, asay I aha meeccii, pooqeel afa kessii woyitheeza.
Liida Yoophphes kale yeza. Ammanizitay Phixiroosa Liida yeza si7ii, «Hayyana nuuko ellisii ye7oba» yeegiz kiita nam77ii asita eeko azazeeza.

Yey gishos, Phixiroosa denddii, unttara yhanigeeza. Hellii, pooqeel afa yez kifile eza gelseeza. Am7itay Phixiroosa kalayir eqqii yeekkittar Dorqqa unttara paxa yezar ootheez qamisitannee afilita ubba Phixiroosa beezeeza.
Phixiroosa unttan ubba bale kessii, gulbatii Xoossa woosseeza. Ma ahayko maaqqii, «Xaabite, denddoba» yeegeeza. Xaabita fa aafa dooyii Phixiroosa bi7ii, denddii betteeza.
Phixiroosa izo fa kusher maaddii denthii esseeza. Yeypp guye, ammanizitannee ami7ta xeegii, denddeezano u tiina ke7eeza.
Yha oday Yoophphe katama ubba helleeza. Gaame asay Goda ammaneeza.
Phixiroosa Yoophphe Simoona giz degelay kara unddenna gallas gam7eeza.
